info.name: WonderTutor API
info.description:
Authentication uses the Postman cookie jar, not bearer tokens. Run "1. Auth > Get CSRF token" first, then the login for the role being tested. Login updates the CSRF variable and the cookie jar stores the HttpOnly session cookie. One cookie jar has one active account: log in as Parent before Parent requests and as Admin before Admin requests. Do not run both logins first and expect separate role sessions. Fetch CSRF again after clearing cookies or logging out.
Use a disposable local/staging database only; several collection requests change or delete records. Seed demo accounts exist only after explicitly seeding that disposable database.
See docs/SAFER_SESSIONS_2026-11-12.md for the cookie/CSRF contract.

Forgot password (code is printed in the backend console)

Answer the tutor's reschedule: accept | decline | withdraw (set the request id)
Create a TRIAL booking request (only the child's first lesson with this tutor)
Leave a review with an optional photo (Cloudinary URL only)
Add one confirmed lesson to a calendar (.ics file)
Add all upcoming confirmed lessons to a calendar (.ics file)
